provenance.canonical-source: apps/v4/registry/new-york-v4/ui/slider.tsx — ONE component (`SliderPrimitive.Root`), rendering a `Track` (`data-slot="slider-track"`) wrapping an ALWAYS-PRESENT `Range` (`data-slot="slider-range"`), plus N `Thumb`s (`data-slot="slider-thumb"`) as SIBLINGS of `Track` under `Root` — thumb COUNT is `Array.from({length: _values.length}, ...)`, driven purely by how many entries `value`/`defaultValue` has, an uncapped N-thumb capability (see prop.value-shape). Token values from apps/v4/app/globals.css (light block from line 100, dark from line 144) — the SAME --muted/--primary/--ring/shadow values every prior shadcn column in this pipeline has resolved from. Read for range/orientation/disabled: slider-demo.tsx, slider-range.tsx, slider-multiple.tsx, slider-vertical.tsx, slider-disabled.tsx, slider-controlled.tsx, field-slider.tsx, slider-rtl.tsx. Read only to fix structural boundaries (NOT canonical): apps/v4/registry/bases/{radix,base,aria}/ui/slider.tsx (the radix base variant moves the identical Root/Track/Range/Thumb shape behind `cn-slider-*` class tokens, same conclusions, no extra capability) and apps/v4/content/docs/components/radix/slider.mdx, which LINKS to but does not itself document Radix's internal element. **primitives/ was NOT cloned**, per the project's standing rule. Every cell depending on Radix's internal element/ARIA wiring (structure.native-input, behavior.role, behavior.value-announcement, behavior.keyboard-value-change, behavior.pointer-drag, behavior.track-click-jump, behavior.form-participation) is marked [R], citing https://www.radix-ui.com/docs/primitives/components/slider.
provenance.n-thumb-capability: slider.tsx's own `_values` memo and the `Array.from({length: _values.length}, ...)` Thumb-mapping loop are the WHOLE mechanism — passing a 3+ element `value` array (`slider-multiple.tsx`) renders 3+ thumbs with NO other code change, confirmed by reading the file directly. This registry's own chassis caps at two thumbs (prop.range) — a declared, out-of-scope reduction of shadcn's own genuinely uncapped capability, recorded rather than silently matched or silently dropped.
provenance.orientation: `data-[orientation=vertical]:h-full data-[orientation=vertical]:min-h-44 ... data-[orientation=vertical]:flex-col` on Root, PLUS matching `data-[orientation=vertical]:h-full data-[orientation=vertical]:w-1.5` on Track and `data-[orientation=vertical]:w-full` on Range — a real, sourced, SHADCN-ONLY capability (slider-vertical.tsx), declared OUT OF SCOPE per the matrix doc's scope note (Salt has no orientation axis at all; M3's Slider class has no orientation-related @property anywhere in slider.ts, confirmed by reading the class directly) rather than silently built or silently dropped.
provenance.primary: Range's own className: `bg-primary` -> globals.css --primary :107 (light) / :150 (dark) — the SAME inversion (near-black light, near-white dark) every prior shadcn column has recorded. Thumb's own `border-primary` reuses the identical slot for its ring border.
provenance.thumb-bg: Thumb's own className: `bg-white` — a LITERAL Tailwind static-white utility, NOT the theme's own `--background` token (checked directly: `bg-white` resolves to the fixed colour white in Tailwind's default palette, unlike `bg-background`, which tracks the theme). MODE-INVARIANT because it is a literal, not a themed slot — a genuinely different mechanism from switch's own `thumb-bg`, which DID track `--background`.
provenance.ring: Thumb's own className: `ring-ring/50` (hover AND focus-visible both reuse it) -> globals.css --ring :119 (light) / :162 (dark).
provenance.shadow-color: Thumb's own className: `shadow-sm` = 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05). Tailwind is not vendored in this clone; reused verbatim from button.shadcn.json's already-extracted value, matching every prior shadcn column's own citation. MODE-INVARIANT.
provenance.no-value-display: CONFIRMED ABSENCE, checked directly against the ENTIRE literal source: no tooltip, no label, no value-text element of any kind renders anywhere in the canonical slider.tsx — the raw value is only ever visible if a CONSUMER renders it themselves (field-slider.tsx does exactly this, printing `{value[0]}`/`{value[1]}` in its own FieldDescription, entirely outside this component).
provenance.no-ticks-no-marks: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no tick-mark or mark-label capability of any kind anywhere in slider.tsx.
provenance.no-readonly: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no readOnly/readonly prop or class anywhere.
provenance.no-format: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no value-formatting prop of any kind; the raw numeric value is the only value this component ever knows about.
